description: Named for the man who never met a mock draft he didn't love. This is the GM who consistently crushes draft day, whether it's nailing early-round picks, uncovering late-round sleepers, or playing mind games at the turn. By the time September rolls around, this dude's roster always looks stacked on paper.

This award honors the GM who masters the in-season chess match. They can manage a locker room of egos, not just X's and O's, and also know when to push the right buttons. Waiver wire pickups, injuries, bye weeks, and underperforming stars don't derail this guy. He is calm under pressure and has mastered the long game.

This award honors the league's most dangerous negotiator. They might be a smooth talker, relentless DM-er, or constantly convincing you that you're getting the better end of the deal...for their 200k mile sedan. Regardless, they always seem to close the deal more than anyone else.

This award goes to the dude who never stops talking...in chat, in trades and in every DM. They're the voice that keeps the group on edge, spitting hot takes, quick to meme, and dropping questionable opinions faster than anyone can respond. Love them or hate them, their commentary dominates the conversation and fuels chaos.

award: Hold My Beer Award (Most Aggressive GM)
description: This award goes to the GM who refuses to play it safe. Big trades, risky lineups, early FAAB dumps, nothing is off limits. They're always riding the fine line between BOOM and BUST, and somehow, they seem perfectly fine with whichever side wins.

No one quite knows what this GM is going to do next...not even them. This award honors the league's most unpredictable force: capable of genius, chaos, or ending up on CTEspn all in the same week. One season they're a contender, the next, they're flexing someone on vibes alone. Entertaining, dangerous, impossible to ignore. This guy's fantasy squad is always an adventure.
